scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Workers with a Visually, Physically or Mentally Disabled Child- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Financial Assistance to Workers with a Visually, Physically or Mentally Disabled Child scheme is an initiative by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

This scheme was launched on 1st January 2019.

It aims to provide financial support to workers who are parents of children with disabilities.

The primary objective of this scheme is to alleviate the financial burden on families with disabled children.

The scheme specifically targets workers in the unorganized sector.

The assistance provided under this scheme is intended to ensure that children with disabilities receive proper care and support.

The financial assistance is set at ₹2,000 per month.

This amount is provided to eligible families to help cover the costs associated with raising a disabled child.

The scheme is designed to support children with visual impairments, physical disabilities, and mental disabilities.

To be eligible for this scheme, applicants must be residents of Haryana.

The applicant must be a registered worker under the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

The child must be between the ages of 0 to 18 years.

The child must have a certified disability as per the guidelines set by the government.

The disability must be recognized by a competent authority.

The family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹2 lakh per annum.

This income limit is set to ensure that the assistance reaches those who are genuinely in need.

The application process involves several specific steps.

First, the applicant must obtain an application form from the Haryana Labour Welfare Board office or download it from the official website.

The completed application form must be submitted along with required documents.

Required documents include a copy of the disability certificate of the child.

The applicant must also provide proof of income.

This can be in the form of a salary slip or income certificate.

Additionally, the applicant must submit proof of identity.

This can include an Aadhar card or voter ID.

The application must be submitted to the nearest Haryana Labour Welfare Board office.

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities.

The processing time for applications is generally around 30 days.

If approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed monthly.

The disbursement is typically made through direct bank transfers.

This ensures that the funds reach the beneficiaries without any delays.

The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

The Board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana.

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the Haryana Labour Welfare Board office.

The contact details can be found on the official Haryana government website.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to support marginalized communities in Haryana.

It reflects the government's commitment to inclusive development.

The scheme aims to empower families by providing them with the necessary financial resources.

This financial assistance can be crucial for families in managing the additional expenses associated with disabilities.

The scheme also aims to promote the welfare of children with disabilities.

It encourages families to provide better care and education for their disabled children.

The government recognizes that children with disabilities often face additional challenges.

These challenges can include limited access to healthcare and education.

By providing financial assistance, the government aims to mitigate these challenges.

The scheme has been positively received by the community.

Many families have reported improvements in their ability to care for their disabled children.

The financial support allows families to invest in necessary therapies and treatments.

It also helps in meeting basic needs such as nutrition and education.

The scheme is part of a larger framework of welfare initiatives in Haryana.

These initiatives aim to uplift the socio-economic status of disadvantaged groups.

The government regularly reviews and updates the scheme to ensure its effectiveness.

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account during these reviews.

The scheme is also aligned with national policies on disability rights.

It supports the objectives of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.

This Act aims to promote and protect the rights of persons with disabilities in India.

The Haryana government is committed to ensuring that all children have equal opportunities.

This includes children with disabilities who require additional support.

The scheme is an essential step towards achieving this goal.

It reflects the government's understanding of the unique challenges faced by families with disabled children.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is crucial for many families.

It helps them to provide a better quality of life for their children.

The scheme also encourages social inclusion for children with disabilities.

By supporting families, the government fosters a more inclusive society.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board continues to work towards improving the scheme.

This includes outreach programs to raise awareness about the scheme.

The government aims to ensure that all eligible families are aware of the assistance available to them.

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to social welfare.

It highlights the importance of supporting vulnerable populations in society.

The financial assistance provided is just one aspect of the government's broader welfare agenda.

The Haryana government is dedicated to creating a more equitable society for all its citizens.

Through initiatives like this, the government aims to empower families and improve their quality of life.

The scheme is an important resource for families navigating the challenges of raising a disabled child.

It underscores the need for targeted support for those in need.

The government continues to monitor the impact of the scheme.

This helps to ensure that it meets the needs of the community effectively.

The Financial Assistance to Workers with a Visually, Physically or Mentally Disabled Child scheme is a vital program.

It plays a critical role in supporting families in Haryana.

The scheme is a clear indication of the government's commitment to social justice and equity.
